engine: coloc.abf (Giambartolomei 2014), single-causal-variant Wakefield ABF, priors p1=p2=1e-4 p12=1e-5

real_data_access_recipe.exposure_pQTL_HP_CD163_ferritin: deCODE 2023 (decodinggenomics.com/health), UKB-PPP Olink (clinicaltrial NCT05449511 / aptamer list), or Sun 2023 Nat Genet trans-ancestry pQTL — request beta/se per SNP for HP, CD163, FTL/FTH.
real_data_access_recipe.exposure_eQTL_HMOX1: GTEx v8 eQTL (HMOX1, whole blood / brain), or eQTLGen — beta/se per cis-SNP.

steps: restrict to cis window (+/-1Mb of gene)
LD not required for coloc.abf (single-variant) but coloc.susie needs a reference panel (1000G)
report PP4; PP4>0.8 = shared causal signal
